blocks.html: Where one or more sides of any pane of glass are not firmly supported, or are subjected to unusual load conditions, or as requested by the applicant, detailed construction documents, detailed shop drawings and analysis or test data ensuring safe performance for the specific installation shall be prepared by a registered design professional.
